text:
nora: Quick heads-up: bringing up qbench-v2 int4 experiments later today. Need a fresh candidate pool and a refreshed golden. target ~95k candidates, golden=1500, holdout 2k for regressions. can we lock ingestion briefly to avoid label drift?

jia: timeframe? i can coordinate label freeze and shard dedupe. also we should run embedding-cluster dedupe first (faiss) then fuzzyhash pass. less false positives on paraphrases.

omar: SG. propose timeline:
- 14:40 UTC: start embedding cluster (200 shards)
- 15:10 UTC: fuzzyhash sweep (th=0.8)
- 15:40 UTC: export quick-golden 3k for spotcheck
- 16:00 UTC: run int4 vs qint8 eval on 2k holdout
If that works i'll pin kernels and reserve 2 GPUs.

curation-ops: noted. we'll temporarily pause label ingestion for channel "curation" between 15:00-17:00 UTC. label-bot will requeue partially-complete jobs older than 8h.

label-bot: pausing ingestion at 15:00 UTC. React :white_check_mark: when ready to resume.

jia: config for dedupe jobs below, will run embedding clusters with cosine prune then fuzzyhash:
```
job: embed-cluster-prune-v1
index: faiss-hnsw32
cosine_threshold: 0.88
shards: 200
followup: fuzzyhash-pass
```
I'll attach shard counts and expected outputs to s3:/rwd-curation/qbench-v2/dedupe-output.

omar: infra-bot, please pin the runtime to image rwd-infer:2026-03-10-int4 and lock CUDA 12.1 kernels for determinism. Also enable KV-cache warmup.

infra-bot: pinned image rwd-infer:2026-03-10-int4, set CUDA=12.1, KV-warmup=true. Autoscaling disabled for job window.

jia: for the golden refresh, recommend keeping 30% long-context (>1024 tokens), 20% non-english, rest diverse intents. will sample stratified.

nora: good. eval-bot, can you prepare a small smoke harness: token-delta, BLEU/ROUGE, hallucination-detector score, and a simple answer-precision metric for QA prompts? We need per-sample diffs + aggregate. Abort threshold: >1.8% drop on precision or >3% on hallucination rate.

eval-bot: harness queued. outputs: per-sample diffs CSV + top-50 regression list. will post when done.

curation-ops: one more ops note: requeue any label batches with >25% annotator dropout before 14:50. I'll run a soft-drain.

nora: ok team — if int4 fails quality gates we fallback to qint8. also capture token-level cost and p95 latency. omar, set up canary route.

omar: canary route created: primary=int4, fallback=qint8, monitor=eval-bot, alert on p95>350ms or quality gate fail.

label-bot: resume requires explicit :white_check_mark:.

jia: i'll run the quick-golden spotcheck (3k) after dedupe, will flag any high variance buckets. plan to sample 500 multilang, 400 longctx, 200 code prompts.

nora: thanks. keep chatter low during the run — only post blockers/regressions. i'll post final go/no-go after eval-bot results.

eval-bot: starting preliminary int4 vs qint8 smoke run at ~16:10 UTC, expect CSV in ~25m.
